activity_summary: You crossed the close to St Helen's while the light was going. From the porch you looked at Sir Thomas Gresham's great plain chest-tomb. You did not go in to stay, and you did not put a hand on the stone.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked in from the porch and turned back toward the close.

facets.activity: Looked at Gresham's tomb from the porch
